Overview:
This project will be a shooter game.

Implementation:
The game is implemented in python

Game Description:
the game has a floating target that bounces across the screen 
the user tries to shoot it with the mouse.
there is a score on the screen for every succuessful hit. 

Game DEsign:
The game is divided into separate python classes according to SRP
Each python class is in it's own module

Coding Conventions:
Each python function starts with the prefix gon_ ( for Gonen )
